purpose: Cover AC-2701-1 through AC-2701-8 via unit tests over the shipped application-account-settings blueprint.json contribution shape (24 contributions in the 6 REQ / 10 US / 4 TAC / 4 ADR groups), the applies-clean pass on a fresh init project with security-auth-magic-link applied, the bare-SPA refusal at exit 3 with the shipped refusal template, the --allow-no-auth-yet override sidecar note, the Q3 refusal for an operator answering security-surface-shape without applied credentialSelfService or hostedIdentityUi, the pack-loader accepting the shipped pack file with every check id cross-checked against blueprint AC ids and appliesTo referencing BOTH tacIds and route, the sample-app fixture serving the five conditional surfaces honestly and refusing on the four break switches, the section 6a capability table extension in blueprint-authoring.md, and the four amended auth blueprints and observability-logging blueprint carrying their new capabilities[] and CHANGELOG entries.
title: application-account-settings v1.0.0 shelf shape, probe pack cross-check, sample-app fixture, auth-minor and observability-logging minor bumps, mechanism minor for Q3 refusal
